Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left.
Complaints centered on low back pain and muscular tightness radiating into the paraspinal region, and the
mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported crash. No prior injury to the lumbar region is known from history or
records reviewed. Over the course of ten visits, the patient received manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home
exercise instruction. Palpation revealed paraspinal muscle guarding and reduced lumbar range of motion, which
support a soft tissue strain, while neurological screening and straight leg raise testing were within normal limits.
Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for a strain of this type, with gradual improvement noetd toward
the fnial visits. Billing review identified one service recorded twice on the same date; the provider acknowledged the
secnod entry was a duplicate and has noted it for correction. Patient was discharged with instructions to return if
symptoms recur.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
